derek chen: Hi all 9999starting today. Quick setup Qs: who handles Aircall provisioning and shared inboxes? Also where's the latest 1-pager for integrations? And is there a short checklist for first-week shadowing?

sophie (sales-ops): welcome derek! Aircall seat + shared inbox requests go through Sales-Ops. Filed ticket SO-8921 for you. Can you confirm preferred caller ID and timezone?  

it-support: @derek chen Aircall provisioning needs your company laptop name and the external number you want as caller ID. Reply here or DM. If you need voicemail transfer, include the old number.

derek chen: laptop name is DC-LAPTOP-03, caller ID should be +1-415-555-0199. I'll DM the old number. Thanks.

jamie enablement: integrations 1-pager is in Notion: https://notion.redwood/sales/1pagers/integrations-v2. Short shadow checklist: 1) watch 2 recorded demos, 2) join 3 live discovery calls as observer, 3) review battlecards for top 3 competitors. I'll add you to the "New AEs" onboarding doc.

nora manager: Welcome! Plan for this week: shadow a qualifying call with Priya tomorrow, brief sync with me Tues 10:30, then try a mock demo Fri. Reach out if you prefer afternoon slots.

onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/newhire-derek 9999Tasks pending: HR forms, laptop inventory, Aircall setup.

sophie (sales-ops): Aircall seat active 705. Shared inbox created for sales+team. You should get invite; let us know if emails don't sync. Also uploaded the latest demo one-pager to drive: https://drive.redwood/sales/onepagers/demo-onepager-2026.pdf

derek chen: Got the invites and doc links. One last Q: any preferred voicemail script or greeting template?

jamie enablement: Use template A for outbound: "Hi, this is Derek from Redwood Inference. Please leave your name and a good time to chat, or email derek@redwood.com." I'll DM a short script pack. :white_check_mark:

derek chen: Perfect, appreciate it. See you all in the onboarding sync. :wave:
